context: living spec: core (Telemetry carries shapes never content; engagement counted without naming what was engaged)
area: src/core/telemetry.ts (TelemetryService is the sole reporter surface; all call sites use sendTelemetryEvent)
constraint: existing event names/shapes frozen; privacy contract unchanged
constraint: never reintroduce a bare /releases/latest lookup or rename published screenshots (repo gotchas)
intent: Restore anonymous usage telemetry by replacing the dead Azure App Insights backend with PostHog while keeping every existing event, switch guarantee, and privacy promise unchanged
expectations: No recovery or import of historical Azure data
No remediation for old installs still posting to the dead endpoint (they resume on upgrade)
No new events, renamed events, or payload additions beyond restoring the common facts the old reporter attached
approach: Swap the transport inside TelemetryService to a direct fetch POST against PostHog's capture endpoint, re-implement the editor-wide gate with vscode.env.isTelemetryEnabled + onDidChangeTelemetryEnabled, and re-attach the common facts (versions, platform, machineId as distinct_id) in the service. Public API and all call sites stay frozen; the old dependency, its mock, and the Azure docs are removed in the same change.

decisions.decision: Direct fetch to PostHog capture API, no SDK
decisions.why: removes a dependency instead of trading it for one; no flush timers in the extension host; trivially small volume; silent-failure by construction
decisions.rejected: posthog-node (batching/retry/flush lifecycle we would have to defuse)

decisions.decision: Cached editor-wide gate fed by onDidChangeTelemetryEnabled
decisions.why: both APIs are spec-pinned; mid-session toggles apply instantly in both directions without restart
decisions.rejected: reading isTelemetryEnabled fresh per send (drops the pinned listener API)

decisions.why: restores what the old reporter attached, adds no new collection, anonymous ingestion class matches the privacy contract
decisions.rejected: minting a per-install UUID in globalState (a second identity, new state)

decisions.decision: Committed POSTHOG_PROJECT_API_KEY constant, empty until the project exists
decisions.why: project keys are write-only like the old ingestion credential; empty key keeps the no-op path so the code merges before the account is created
decisions.rejected: build-time env injection (breaks plain-checkout builds for a value safe to commit)

decisions.decision: Shared fetch-capture test helper lives at src/core/__tests__/helpers/telemetryFetch.ts
decisions.why: the production tsconfig (rootDir ./src) also type-checks test files, so a helper outside src/ fails TS6059; inside __tests__ it is excluded from test discovery and reusable by both suites
decisions.rejected: tests/helpers/ (outside rootDir, breaks npm run compile)

decisions.decision: Default-key behavior test asserts conditionally on POSTHOG_PROJECT_API_KEY being non-empty
decisions.why: the suite stays green both before and after the maintainer pastes the real key, without edits
decisions.rejected: hard-coding the empty-key expectation (breaks the moment the key lands)
